tree: clean at measurement; profile scopes added and later reverted
instrumentation_note: Each scope is a QueryPerformanceCounter pair, so per-call overhead (~60-80 ns) is counted twice in every child-counted row. Absolute substage totals for the 200000-iteration rows are inflated by that overhead; the RANKING is unaffected. Aggregate rows (export total, publish total) were measured with the same process and were cross-checked against the un-instrumented benchmark.

unaccounted_publish_time_ms.note: MergeIndexDirectories_total (25.3) includes its by-value std::map parameter copy, which is NOT inside any instrumented scope. The difference between the instrumented function total and the measured publication row is the parameter copy.
unaccounted_publish_time_ms.verdict: harness defect, not product cost: every production call site passes a prvalue or std::move, so no copy exists in the product path

conclusion: Export is dominated by per-entry std::wstring construction (childNameToWString) inside childEntryBuild. Publication's dominant real cost is SerializedSnapshotSize + serializeWrite + previous-mapping teardown.
